title: Eight-sided polynomial decoder with rank costs (0, 1, 1, 2) and budget 2

claims.statement: The explicit five-component 2000-use polynomial-tag decoder with rank costs (0, 1, 1, 2) and a per-group cost cap of 2 has uniform-message average block error at most 493025626292437661/500000000000000000 on BSC(1/10).
The same fixed bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes exactly W=331172 primitives on every input, with W<=2^(1833723/100000).

experiments.purpose: Check exact local spectra and one cumulative pair profile under both sum and individual distance cutoffs. The last sector also verifies the two exact score claims and finite decoder count.
